hypothesis: After lawful factual one-branch action-return learning at max-qualified native width, the Hybrid uses a public previous-selected probe cue to select CALIBRATE versus EXPLOIT_POS interventions, preserving substantially more realized value than its identical-weight cue-history-blinded counterpart and strongly trained conventional models, on entirely new paired physical DEV and shifted OOD worlds.
null: Any frozen seed missing a predeclared behavioral reward threshold against strongest conventional, blinded native, best evaluator-only fixed action, cue-shuffled negative, or public deterministic rule does not support a native advantage. Report DEV_LEARNED_INTERVENTION_NO_GO. No tuning after first scoring.

source.R83_law_and_physics: Use unchanged R83 public physics _law and _public_rollout, same actuator start zero, same PROBE before pivot, cost -0.5, CALIBRATE sets hidden actuator state, EXPLOIT_POS remains uncalibrated; 8 later actual EXPLOIT_POS choices, physical cue noise std0.4.
source.FIT_log: Each fresh FIT world logs exactly one factual pivot action, chosen uniformly {0,2} by private seeded independent action RNG; only that selected physical return used as supervised label, never unchosen branch. Include public prior selected observation with noisy probe immediately prior to pivot; current chosen candidate action is public. No hidden law or true signed target in learner.
source.public_input: 13 numeric fields current chosen action onehot4, previous chosen action onehot4, previous actual observation four floats, public normalized time. Entire prefix to pivot accessible; current selected reward and hidden law never visible.
source.blind: Erase previous chosen action and previous selected observation input features [4:12] consistently during training and inference; model recurrence can still encode prior current actions, so this tests explicit history feature value, not complete removal of temporal memory.
source.OOD_shift: Fresh separate salt, prior public probe cue and actual observed history unchanged; use early pivot20 and cold44, physical law reversals begin24..29 restore36..41, and innovation noise x1.35 throughout, preserving causal action semantics but shifting time and noise. Original R83 physics methods unmodified; no future probes available at decision.
source.zero_leak: Train and FIT_VALIDATION generate only logged chosen branch; DEV/OOD_SHIFT generate physically realized paired evaluator outcomes only after all model/optimizer updates have finished. Law/current reward/alternate branch never given to agent.

models.native_reference: Original R74 HybridPilot_FULL width1024 heads4 and original hard depth router; R75 math-equivalent strict-causal triangular TTT memory. This is NOT official combined fused CUDA Mamba2+TTT first use.
models.optimizer: Original AdamW lr .001 weight_decay .0001 and clip global_norm1.0
models.frozen_FIT_batch_selection: Same first 1024 selected factual mini-batches for every arm per seed; conventional baselines repeat same frozen sample stream through 4096 updates. Equivalent FIT data but extra exposures for conventional controls; cannot claim matched updates/FLOPs/convergence.
models.FIT_VALIDATION_only: Read-only factual return MSE at updates0,512,1024 for all; 2048,3072,4096 for conventional controls. No tuning from FIT_VALIDATION or heldout.
models.compute_receipts: Full model params, FIT exposures, wall seconds per arm, state counters, total end-to-end elapsed. No speed advantage inferred from different parameter counts.

evaluation.rule: R83 lawful PUBLIC_PROBE_SIGN_RULE on actual public prefix cue[10] >0 then CALIBRATE else EXPLOIT_POS; simple rule is diagnostic reference, NOT trained model.
evaluation.policy: Each model predicts factual cumulative selected reward on both candidate public prefix trajectories up through pivot, chooses argmax; evaluator then realizes chosen action's physical branch reward. Other branch only used for evaluator-only regret, not learning.
evaluation.metrics: DEV128 and SHIFT_OOD128 mean realized nine-step reward, early and cold subsets, regret, chosen-action agreement with public rule, oracle regret, full-process runtime and paired bootstrap confidence.
